$comment: Privacy labels as data (M7.5a). Derived from the SDKs and permissions the app ships; `pnpm --filter @yayatoh/staff privacy:check` fails when the dependency or permission lists stop matching. Copy these answers into App Store Connect (App Privacy) and Play Console (Data safety) by hand; see docs/runbooks/mobile-release.md.

name.why: The name of a signed-in organizer or exhibitor rep. A door device has no personal account.

email.why: An organizer's or rep's sign-in address; the emailed code goes to it.

user_id.why: The account id of a signed-in organizer or rep.

device_id.play: Device or other IDs / Device or other IDs
device_id.why: The enrolled door device's id (shown on the organizer's device board) and, after the person turns staff alerts on, its push token.

other_diagnostic_data.why: The device heartbeat every 30 seconds: battery level, scans waiting to send and clock offset, so the organizer sees which doors are healthy.

other_user_content.why: Exhibitor reps' ratings, notes and qualifier answers on leads, and the manual check-in reason. Visitors' contact details are returned by the server only where the visitor consented and are not collected from the phone.

crash_data.play: App info and performance / Crash logs
crash_data.why: Scrubbed crash reports to Sentry (a processor acting for Yayatoh); no user id, name, email, ticket code or token.

@noble/ciphers.why: Encrypts the cache, tickets and guest list on the phone. Local only.

@noble/curves.why: Verifies ticket signatures (Ed25519) on the phone. Local only.

@noble/hashes.why: Hashing and key derivation on the phone. Local only.

@sentry/react-native.why: Crash reports, scrubbed of names, emails, codes and tokens before they leave the phone. Off unless a DSN is configured. No screenshots, no view hierarchy, no performance traces (tracesSampleRate 0).

@tanstack/react-query-persist-client.why: Persists the cache as one encrypted file on the phone. Local only.

expo.why: Runtime and module loader. No data of its own.

expo-apple-authentication.why: Sign in with Apple: the identity token goes to Yayatoh's API, which is first-party (email and name labels).

expo-application.why: Reads the app version and install identifiers for the version check; not sent as an identifier.

expo-audio.why: Plays the scan result sounds. Local only.

expo-auth-session.why: Google sign-in in the system browser with PKCE; the id token goes to Yayatoh's API (first-party).

expo-battery.why: Reads the battery level for the device heartbeat, which Yayatoh's API shows organizers on the device board.

expo-camera.why: Reads QR codes (enrolment code). Frames are not stored or sent.

expo-crypto.why: Random numbers and hashes on the phone. Local only.

expo-dev-client.why: Development builds only; not in a store build.

expo-file-system.why: Stores the encrypted cache on the phone. Local only.

expo-haptics.why: Vibration for scan results. Local only.

expo-linking.why: Opens universal links and the app scheme. Local only.

expo-localization.why: Reads the phone language to pick a catalog. Local only.

expo-network.why: Reads connectivity state for the offline banner. Local only.

expo-notifications.why: Gets the APNs or FCM push token after the person allows notifications. Yayatoh's API stores it per phone and per organization to send the person's own ticket and order messages.

expo-secure-store.why: Keeps tokens and keys in the Keychain or Keystore. Local only.

expo-sqlite.why: Encrypted (SQLCipher) guest list on the phone. Local only; deleted at wipe or after the event.

expo-updates.why: EAS Update checks for JavaScript fixes. The request carries the platform, runtime version and update id, and no user or device identifier.

expo-web-browser.why: Opens the secure checkout and sign-in pages in the system browser session.

react-native-nitro-image.why: Image handling for the camera library. Local only.

react-native-nitro-modules.why: Native module bridge for the camera library. Local only.

react-native-vision-camera.why: Reads ticket and badge QR codes. Frames are not stored or sent.

ios:NSCameraUsageDescription.why: Reads QR codes only; frames are not stored or sent.

android:android.permission.CAMERA.why: Reads QR codes only; frames are not stored or sent.

play.deletionPath: A door device needs no account: an organizer removes the device, which erases its token and guest list. Organizer and exhibitor accounts are deleted from the Yayatoh web account page (${STORE_ACCOUNT_DELETION_URL}).
